source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: At the moment you choose this unit to shoot, you can pay one [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain) to Empower it, provided it is your [Shooting Phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase). The same option is available when choosing it for combat during the [Fight Phase](vsdata:core-rule/fight-phase). While Empowered, its models can reroll a [Wound result](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) showing 1. If the target lies within an objective marker’s control range, the reroll is available for any [Wound result](vsdata:core-rule/wound-rolls) instead.
